narrative.text:
The worktree is at the required base. I found a scope boundary: A’s preflight validates the verdict and then returns; it has no post-verdict hook within the same timeout/cancellation boundary. B’s §3.3 consumer needs that hook before admission effects. I’m stopping before edits to request the required clarification.The approved admission hook is committed separately. Both baseline suites passed on Node 22.23.3 and 22.12.0: 9,538 passed, 63 skipped, no failures.

The in-progress B patch now carries private bindings through queued work and continuations, freezes turn destinations, and checks them on automatic sends. The focused ownership suite passes; I’m testing the real-transport paths and N1–N4 witnesses next.The first full runs found nine regressions in the existing rewind tests: their lightweight harness has no routing map, and my new ownership capture assumed one existed. I’ll make that lookup optional, rerun those unchanged tests, then rerun both full suites. The 228-test focused gate and all ten mutation checks passed.Both Node-version full suites passed: 9,602 passed, 0 failed, and 63 skipped each. The focused suite passed all 228 tests, and all ten mutation checks caught their intended faults. I’m completing the report and checking upstream freshness; no rebase or push will be performed.
